description: Frame budgets (ADR-0018): per path scene and resolution, the GPU milliseconds per pass at the median and the p99 of the path's frames, and the frame thread's cpu_ms, that a merge may not push a run past (beyond the tolerance). tools/frame-budget.ps1 is the gate; docs/subsystems/bench.md "Frame budgets" is the format and how to re-baseline.

runs.sources: Every number measured 2026-10-07 (this baseline). Its total agrees with docs/experiments/world-positions-renderer-2026-10-05.md (stage 3, rt after: 0.730 / 1.453 ms median / p99; the A/B runs 0.723-0.727 / 1.516-1.634); that page has no per-pass numbers at 1080p.

baseline.reason: Re-pinned at the level main itself reads when built in a checkout against the ddc: the batch 56 gate (2026-11-08) read the total at 3.782 against the 3.760 limit, and paired runs the same day put main 86b543cb's source at resolve 2.540 / total 3.75 and the batch's tree 19f9d15d at 2.531-2.551, the same within noise, so the climb since the 2026-10-13 pin (about +0.22 ms resolve) is main's and unattributed (R138 measured no step on the sister run); a binary installed outside a checkout reads 0.09 ms less on the resolve because it finds no ddc and samples decoded RGBA8 textures instead of the built BC ones, so it is not a baseline for pairing; the blas, clas and total p99s are kept at the previous baseline's values because this one flight's tail inflated them (0.404 / 0.493 / 4.455 against 0.227 / 0.242 / 4.25-4.37 in five other flights the same day) and the run's own are within their limits.

runs.sources: The GPU medians, the other p99s and the cpu lines re-measured 2026-11-08 on 19f9d15d, the batch 56 gate's tree at main's own level (the reason); the blas, clas and total p99s kept from the 2026-11-07 baseline (the reason says why). Before that: every number re-measured 2026-11-07 on main 8be9c6d4, hw kept from 2026-10-12. The 2026-10-07 seed: its medians agreed with docs/experiments/world-positions-renderer-2026-10-05.md (stage 1 cost, erg rt after: cull 0.096, hw 0.286, rt 0.605, resolve 2.328, total 3.458 ms) to within 2%; that page has no p99s.

baseline.reason: Measured drift, not a change under test: on 2026-10-12 main's own installed binary (f8ed3892) and the batch 16 tree measure the same, endless-surround3-rt hw median 0.43 ms against 0.323 on 2026-10-11 19:30 and cull 0.085 against 0.068 (three flights each, no rebuilds), and endless-1080p-csm total median 3.08-3.2 against the 2026-10-07 seed 2.916 after the HDR encode, F18 and the fold guard each landed within tolerance; the 1080p cull/sky/resolve p99 tails spike about 2x on main too (one of three quiet flights), so the p99 absolute slack goes from 0.1 to 0.4 ms in the same change

runs.sources: Every number measured 2026-10-07 (this baseline). docs/experiments/far-ground-2026-10-03.md (1080p, six far levels, csm) reads 2.980 / 5.103 ms total median / p99, cull 0.306, shadow 0.831, resolve 0.488 at the median: today's tree measures about half that on the same path (1.6 ms), so those numbers were not taken — as a budget they would pass a doubling.

baseline.reason: Measured drift on main, not a change under test: on 2026-11-07 main's own 8be9c6d4 flies this run at a resolve median of 2.100 ms (quiet) against the 1.885 pinned on 2026-10-12, a climb the gate's own results date to 1.81-1.90 (10-12 to 10-16), 1.87-1.96 (to 10-27), 1.98-2.00 (to 10-31) and 2.10-2.12 (11-01 to 11-06), its largest step over batch 47's merges of 10-31 (R115 stage 1 split the resolve by stage; unconfirmed); the batch 54 tree adds about 0.08 ms on top (2.166-2.186 in three runs; R136's terrain sampling the likeliest, not bisected) and stays visible under this budget; the numbers are main's run read from its summary (-FromSummaries), except hw, kept at the 2026-10-12 0.427/0.503 by hand because main flips between 0.31 and 0.43 from run to run (0.433 on 11-01, 0.312 on 11-02) and a 0.310 budget would fail the gate on the next 0.43; roadmap R138 finds the climb

The 2026-10-07 seed: its medians agreed with docs/experiments/world-positions-renderer-2026-10-05.md (stage 2 cost, rt after: cull 0.065, deform 0.039, hw 0.312, rt 0.944, resolve 1.861, total 4.363 ms) to within 8% pass by pass and 2% in total (4.454 today). Its cpu_ms median agrees with docs/experiments/frame-thread-spikes-2026-10-04.md (0.43 ms, traced shadows after) at 0.455; its p99 is 1.305 against that page's 0.71, on a machine this run called busy.
